notes: Corrected the treatment of מַחֲזִיקֵי בִדְקֵךְ: the participle and בֶּדֶק now share one unit under rule 30's one-English-word fusion, headed on מַחֲזִיקֵי, instead of leaving בֶּדֶק unrepresented.

Everything else in the verse was verified and left as accepted: the three-'the' distribution across אֳנִיּוֹת הַיָּם follows rule 29, and the 'in' of 'deal in thy merchandise' stays with the verb under rule 44 because the object is bare.
